meta.name: hivemind-graph
meta.description: Query the local AST-derived code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) for structural codebase questions — what calls X, what does Y import, where is Z defined, blast radius of a change. The graph rebuilds automatically after each agent turn; use hivemind_graph_search and hivemind_graph_neighborhood tools (no manual build step).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询代码结构，分析调用关系与变更影响范围
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在大型代码库中快速理解函数调用链和变更影响
copy.tagline_en: Query code structure, analyze call relationships and change impact
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand function call chains and change impact in a large codebase

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询代码库的结构关系，比如谁调用了某个函数、某个文件导入了什么、某个符号定义在哪里。它自动维护代码图谱，你只需提问，不用手动构建。
howto.when: 当你问代码的结构或关系问题，比如“谁调用了 X”、“Y 导入了什么”、“Z 定义在哪里”时触发。

say.text: 谁调用了 pushSnapshot 函数？
say.note: Claude 会搜索并返回调用者列表。
Claude 会列出该文件的导入关系。
Claude 会定位符号定义的文件和行号。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query the codebase's structural relationships, such as who calls a function, what a file imports, or where a symbol is defined. The graph is maintained automatically; you only need to ask questions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask structural or relational questions about the code, e.g., 'Who calls X?', 'What does Y import?', 'Where is Z defined?'.

say_en.note: Claude will search and return callers.
Claude will list the imports of that file.
Claude will locate the symbol's file and line.
